prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Dubnium (Db) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a riverside wakeboard pontoon of her element's kingdom — a floating deck, a towline cable over the water and boards racked by the rail
Time of day: golden hour — warm low sun, long shadows; the warm low sun rim-lighting her hair.
Light direction: dappled light — patches of light with leaf or blind shadow across her.
Outfit: a wakeboard instructor look fitted to her body — a cropped rash top over a bikini top, short board shorts and a waist leash, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera slightly above, looking down at her.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand rests on her hip.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand tucks hair behind her ear.
LEGS: weight on one leg, the other knee softly bent.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: one eye closed in a playful wink while the other stays open and bright, one mouth corner lifted in a small smile, brows relaxed.
Scene note: she is the wakeboard instructor waiting on the pontoon for the next run, her board propped beside her

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — dubnium: a heavy synthetic metal below niobium and tantalum, named for a research town founded in 1956 in pine and oak forest where two great rivers meet, a name said to hide an old word for oak; claimed almost at once by that river town and by a hillside laboratory across the ocean, it passed through several proposed names in a naming quarrel that lasted nearly thirty years before the river town's name was given to it; the town once held the largest particle accelerator on earth, a ring of iron magnets weighing tens of thousands of tonnes in a riverside hall, and its longest-lived form lasts about a day — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: strong and broad-shouldered with firm muscle, yet full-busted with wide rounded hips and a defined waist — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
